title: s, p, d and f Blocks
short: Which block does an element sit in?
trouble: Confusing the symbol's language (Latin names) with the English name.

blocks.html: The periodic table is a map you can read. This drill works on which block does an element sit in?.
Tip: Two columns on the left are s, six to the right are p, the middle ten are d, the bottom fourteen are f.
Questions are generated from the published element data — the same numbers the Periodic table dataset shows.
